quote: Recently, large language models have shown impressive performance in text and code generation, reasoning, and decision-making tasks, which paves the way for building an agent to automate computer tasks.

quote: We evaluated CER on two realistic web benchmarks WEBARENA and VISUALWEBARENA... On VISUALWEBARENA, CER outperforms the tree search based method by 20.8% in relative performance with dozens of times fewer token costs...
